title: RECAP: Training Long-horizon LLM Agents with Context Compaction
title_zh: RECAP：通过上下文压缩训练长程 LLM 智能体
abstract_en: Context compaction enables large language model agents to tackle long-horizon tasks within limited context budgets by replacing interaction histories with compressed summaries. However, learning effective compaction jointly with the agent policy remains challenging, as summaries affect task success over many subsequent interactions. We introduce RECAP, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework based on the principle that a summary should preserve the behavior induced by the original interaction history. We formalize this principle with a behavior distortion objective that measures the divergence between the agent's subsequent behavior under compressed and original contexts. We show that the gradient of the distortion objective decomposes into two complementary learning signals: distortion-based reward for summary generation and self-distillation for subsequent actions. Experiments on Qwen3.5-4B show that RECAP consistently outperforms the task-reward-only RL baselines on both environments, leading to an absolute improvement of 4.6% and 4.3% on BrowseComp-plus and SWE-bench Verified, respectively. Ablations further highlight the value of jointly supervising summary generation and post-compaction behavior for RECAP.
abstract_zh: 上下文压缩（context compaction）用摘要替换交互历史，使大语言模型智能体能在有限的上下文预算内处理长程任务。然而，摘要会影响此后多轮交互，因此很难将摘要生成与智能体策略联合训练。为此，论文提出强化学习框架 RECAP，其核心原则是：摘要应尽量保留原始交互历史所诱导的后续行为。RECAP 用行为失真目标（behavior distortion objective）衡量智能体在压缩上下文与原始上下文下的后续行为差异，并将该目标的梯度分解为两种互补的学习信号：用基于失真的奖励训练摘要生成，用自蒸馏（self-distillation）训练压缩后的后续动作。在 Qwen3.5-4B 上，RECAP 相比仅使用任务奖励的强化学习基线，在 BrowseComp-plus 和 SWE-bench Verified 上分别提升 4.6 和 4.3 个百分点。消融实验进一步表明，同时监督摘要生成和压缩后的行为有助于提升性能。
key_points_zh: RECAP 以压缩前后智能体的后续行为差异为训练信号，而不只依赖最终任务奖励。
行为失真目标的梯度提供两种学习信号：基于失真的摘要生成奖励，以及以原始上下文下的行为为参照的后续动作自蒸馏。
在 Qwen3.5-4B 上，相比仅使用任务奖励的强化学习基线，BrowseComp-plus 和 SWE-bench Verified 分别提升 4.6 和 4.3 个百分点。
消融实验表明，联合监督摘要生成与压缩后的行为有助于提升性能。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 核心贡献是用行为失真奖励与自蒸馏联合训练摘要生成和压缩后的行动策略，使通用文本与软件智能体能从交互轨迹中改进可复用策略。相对仅用任务奖励的强化学习基线，两个基准分别提升4.6和4.3个百分点。摘要未给出复现细节或具体消融结果，也未表明改进机制本身会递归改进。
